chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Decatur and Morris Brown: playing without reading
summary: He played under the lights in Decatur, taught by a white professor from Agnes Scott.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That was while you were around Georgia or while you were around Atlanta?
You went to school in Decatur?
Yes, and I went to school in Morris Brown College. I played then but I played in Decatur, Georgia, on the trombone. Couldn't read a note and played under the lights.
Yeah, you know, at night. We'd go out and have a ball...
What other musicians did you play with then? We asked you about some of the other fellows that you played with in the band.
It was a white teacher teaching us. Professor Scott from - you know that school too - Agnes Scott College in Atlanta, Georgia. I know you heard of that. It was a white school. He was teaching us.
